question.text: Bleaching powder and bleach solution are produced on a large scale and used in several household products. The effectiveness of bleach solution is often measured by iodometry. Question: Bleaching powder contains a salt of an oxoacid as one of its components. The anhydride of that oxoacid is

solution.text:
$\mathrm{Ca}(\mathrm{OCl}) \mathrm{Cl} \longrightarrow \mathrm{Ca}^{2+}+-\mathrm{OCl}+\mathrm{Cl}^{-}$

-OCl (Hypochlorite ion) is anion of the acid HOCl which on dehydration gives $\mathrm{Cl}_{2} \mathrm{O}$.

$2 \mathrm{HOCl} \longrightarrow \mathrm{H}_{2} \mathrm{O}+\mathrm{Cl}_{2} \mathrm{O}$
